result.instructions: Tools for X (Twitter), hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the 20 most recent posts that mention our product name, English only, without retweets."; "Look up the X account @XDevelopers and show its follower count and bio."; "List the last 10 posts from our company account, excluding replies.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes X (Twitter) data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run twitterx_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run twitterx_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run twitterx_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. twitterx_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: twitterx_get_user_by_username
tools.title: Get a user by username
tools.description: Look up an X user by username and return the user object (id, name, description, public metrics). Use this first to get the numeric user id the other tools need. X API: GET /2/users/by/username/{username}.

username.description: X username, with or without the leading @.

user_fields.description: Comma list of user fields, e.g. description,public_metrics,verified.

tools.name: twitterx_get_user
tools.title: Get a user by id
tools.description: Get one X user by numeric id, with the requested user fields. X API: GET /2/users/{id}.

user_fields.description: Comma list of user fields, e.g. description,public_metrics,verified.

tools.name: twitterx_get_me
tools.title: Get the authenticated user
tools.description: Return the X account that owns the token. Needs a user-context OAuth 2.0 access token; an app-only Bearer Token gets an error. X API: GET /2/users/me.

user_fields.description: Comma list of user fields, e.g. description,public_metrics,verified.

tools.name: twitterx_get_followers
tools.title: List followers
tools.description: List the followers of a user, one page at a time (up to 1000 per page). Follow meta.next_token for more. X API: GET /2/users/{id}/followers.

pagination_token.description: Pagination token from meta.next_token of the previous page.

user_fields.description: Comma list of user fields, e.g. description,public_metrics,verified.

tools.name: twitterx_create_post
tools.title: Create a post
tools.description: Publish one post from the authenticated account, only when the user asks for it. Needs a user-context access token and uses pay-per-usage credits. Set reply_to_post_id to reply to a post. X API: POST /2/tweets.

reply_to_post_id.description: Post id to reply to, if any.

tools.name: twitterx_delete_post
tools.title: Delete a post
tools.description: Delete one post from the authenticated account, only when the user asks for it. This cannot be undone. Needs a user-context access token. X API: DELETE /2/tweets/{id}.
